message.content:
要把 166 公升（L）換算成美制加仑（gal），可以使用以下公式：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{\text{Litres}}{3.78541}
\]

將數值代入：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{166}{3.78541}\;\text{≈}\;43.9\,\text{gal}
\]

所以，**166 公升相當於大約 44 加侖**（四捨五入到整個加侖）。如果你想更精準地知道每一小時或每天消耗多少，可以再細分路程距離與車輛燃效等參數喔！
message.reasoning:
The user wants conversion from liters to gallons. There's a tool `liters_to_gallons`? Actually we have `gallon_to_liter`, but not reverse. We could compute manually: 1 US gallon ≈ 3.78541 L. So 166 L / 3.78541 = ~43.8 gallons.

We need to respond accordingly. No tool call necessary. Just answer.

\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{\text{Litres}}{3.78541}
\]

將數值代入：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{166}{3.78541}\;\text{≈}\;43.9\,\text{gal}
\]

We need to respond accordingly. No tool call necessary. Just answer.")

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{\text{Litres}}{3.78541}
\]

將數值代入：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{166}{3.78541}\;\text{≈}\;43.9\,\text{gal}
\]

所以，**166 公升相當於大約 44 加侖**（四捨五入到整個加侖）。如果你想更精準地知道每一小時或每天消耗多少，可以再細分路程距離與車輛燃效等參數喔！', refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[], reasoning="The user wants conversion from liters to gallons. We need to respond accordingly. No tool call necessary. Just answer.")

ChatCompletionMessage(content='要把 166 公升（L）換算成美制加仑（gal），可以使用以下公式：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{\text{Litres}}{3.78541}
\]

將數值代入：

\[
\text{Gallons} \approx \frac{166}{3.78541}\;\text{≈}\;43.9\,\text{gal}
\]

所以，**166 公升相當於大約 44 加侖**（四捨五入到整個加侖）。如果你想更精準地知道每一小時或每天消耗多少，可以再細分路程距離與車輛燃效等參數喔！', refusal=None, role='assistant', annotations=None, audio=None, function_call=None, tool_calls=[], reasoning="The user wants conversion from liters to gallons. There's a tool `liters_to_gallons`? Actually we have `gallon_to_liter`, but not reverse. We could compute manually: 1 US gallon ≈ 3.78541 L. So 166 L / 3.78541 = ~43.8 gallons.

We need to respond accordingly. No tool call necessary. Just answer.")
